mapper.select: SELECT a.assign_id, a.paper_id, a.class_id, a.teacher_account, a.assign_status, a.assign_remark, a.assign_time, p.paper_no, p.paper_name, p.paper_subject, p.paper_grade_level, p.paper_grade, p.paper_total_score, p.paper_question_count, p.paper_duration, c.class_name FROM edu_paper_assign a LEFT JOIN edu_paper p ON p.paper_id = a.paper_id LEFT JOIN edu_class c ON c.class_id = a.class_id WHERE a.teacher_account = #{teacherAccount} ORDER BY a.assign_time DESC, a.assign_id DESC

SELECT a.assign_id, a.paper_id, a.class_id, a.teacher_account, a.assign_status, a.assign_remark, a.assign_time, p.paper_no, p.paper_name, p.paper_subject, p.paper_grade_level, p.paper_grade, p.paper_total_score, p.paper_question_count, p.paper_duration, c.class_name FROM edu_paper_assign a JOIN edu_paper p ON p.paper_id = a.paper_id LEFT JOIN edu_class c ON c.class_id = a.class_id WHERE a.class_id = #{classId} AND a.assign_status = 1 AND p.paper_status = 1 ORDER BY a.assign_time DESC, a.assign_id DESC
